title: Count and Write Worksheets for Kindergarten
intro: Teach one-to-one counting by matching one spoken number to one picture.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Have the student point to or mark each picture once. Ask them to repeat the final number to name the whole collection.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

Try it with six counters: move each counted counter to a new row while saying one number word. Stop when every counter has moved.

The last number spoken tells how many counters are in the whole group. It does not describe only the last counter.

Ask your student

How can we keep track of the pictures already counted?

If your student needs help

If a picture is counted twice, use a steady pointing path or movable counters.
